integrity: Complete proof, explicit character lattices, local semigroup descriptions, and a standalone finite checker supplied. Finite tests are not substituted for infinite proofs. The primary-source date is the original preprint submission, not a revision.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter statement covers only \(m\ge3\) and the normal-fan toric variety. The full singular scheme and the intersection scheme of singular components are not determined; no independent audit is claimed.
title: Mixed-dimensional singularities of complete-bipartite graphical-zonotope toric varieties
